# Specter

> Automated website change monitor & visual diff tracking.

Specter is an automated website monitoring tool that detects visual and content changes across any public web page on scheduled intervals and delivers instant alerts.

## Key Capabilities
- **Visual Diff Tracking**: Capture page snapshots and compare them side-by-side with an interactive comparison slider.
- **Scheduled Monitoring**: Configure automated checks on your custom schedule—from every 15 minutes to daily intervals.
- **Instant Alerts**: Dispatch notifications to Telegram channels/bots, custom Webhook endpoints (Discord, Slack, Zapier), and email.
- **Dynamic Modern Web Support**: Fully renders dynamic web pages and interactive content before evaluating changes.

## Target Use Cases
- Tracking competitor pricing and product availability changes.
- Monitoring regulatory, compliance, and legal terms updates.
- Detecting website defacement, unexpected visual changes, and layout regressions.
- Keeping track of critical page modifications without manual inspection.
